title: Actually run the width+batch-size stack
description: Kept ASPECT_RATIO=96 (round-0 width win), changed TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE from 2**19 to 2**18 (round-0 batch-size win) on top of it; grad_accum_steps auto-halves, doubling optimizer steps within the 5-min budget at the wider model.
reflection: val_bpb 0.982613 vs baseline 0.998671, a clean ~1.6% further improvement -- confirms the two round-0 wins ARE additive, ending two rounds of everyone proposing this and nobody running it. This is now the best result in the cell. Given the pattern, the group should look for a third orthogonal axis next (e.g. LR schedule shape, weight decay, or a genuinely untested part of the architecture) rather than pushing width or batch-size further, since both have already been shown to fail when pushed past their current values (ASPECT_RATIO=128 failed 3x, DEPTH=10 failed 2x, both likely confounded by forced DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE cuts).
